title: How to Cancel Cursor Pro in the Dashboard (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Cursor Pro from the Cursor dashboard: open Billing, turn off renewal, and keep your projects on the limited Hobby plan.
intro: Cursor subscriptions are sold directly through Cursor. Open the dashboard, find Billing, and cancel renewal there. Your projects and settings remain; the current Hobby plan has limited Agent requests and limited Tab completions, while exact usage limits may change.

steps.title: Open Cursor settings
steps.text: Visit cursor.com/dashboard while signed in, or open Cursor → click your avatar → Settings → Account to reach the web dashboard.

steps.title: Navigate to Subscription/Billing
steps.text: Find the "Subscription" or "Billing" section in your account settings. You'll see your current plan and renewal date.

steps.title: Click "Cancel Plan" or "Downgrade"
steps.text: Click the cancel or downgrade option. Cursor may ask for feedback or offer a retention deal.
steps.tip: Cursor currently describes Hobby as limited Agent requests and limited Tab completions; it no longer publishes the old fixed 2,000/50 quotas.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Confirm your cancellation. Pro features remain active until the end of your billing cycle, then you switch to the Hobby plan.

warnings: Cursor Hobby has limited Agent requests and Tab completions; check the live pricing page for current limits.
Your projects, settings, and extensions are preserved on the free plan.
If you paid annually, check the refund policy for unused months.
Business/Team plan members should contact their admin for cancellation.

faqs.q: What's included in Cursor's free plan?
faqs.a: Cursor currently lists Hobby as free with limited Agent requests and limited Tab completions. Pro adds extended Agent limits and access to frontier models. Exact usage is shown in Cursor's live pricing and dashboard.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Cursor?
faqs.a: Contact Cursor at hi@cursor.com with the account email, charge date, amount, and reason. Cursor does not publish a universal refund promise, so eligibility is reviewed case by case.

faqs.q: Will I lose my settings and extensions?
faqs.a: No. All your Cursor settings, keybindings, extensions, and project configurations are preserved regardless of plan.

faqs.q: What's a free alternative to Cursor?
faqs.a: VS Code with GitHub Copilot Free, Codeium extension, or Windsurf (Codeium's IDE) offer similar AI coding assistance on free tiers.

refund.details: Contact hi@cursor.com with the account email, charge date, amount, and usage details. Refund eligibility is reviewed case by case and is not guaranteed.

retentionTactics: Cursor may offer a discount or extended trial of Pro features.
